# Lumen RXD Wallet v0.1.3

This release fixes how the wallet discovers addresses and how it reports activity, so your balance and transaction list match what is actually on-chain.

## Fixes
- **Missing addresses are now found.** Receive and change addresses are discovered with a proper BIP-44 gap limit (walking both chains by activity) instead of only the addresses already known — so funds on higher or previously-used addresses are no longer hidden.
- **Change-chain support.** Internal (change) addresses under `m/44'/…/1/i` are now derived, scanned, displayed and spendable, so change that a standard wallet parks on the change chain is included in your balance.
- **Sends no longer appear as large receives.** Each transaction is classified from the signed net effect (`received − spent`), resolved from the raw transaction and each input's previous output. The amount shown includes the fee, and outgoing payments display the amount you actually sent rather than the change coming back.

## Changes
- **Activity colours match the mobile app:** green ↓ for received, blue ↑ for sent, dim ⇄ for self-transfers.
- **Counterparty shown on every transaction** — the recipient on sends and the sender on receives (shortened address).

## Notes
- The first sync after launch runs the gap-limit discovery and parses recent transactions, so it may take a few seconds longer once.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theklunky/lumen-rxd-wallet/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
